answer: One concrete defense is bonded, rate-limited attestation. Every agent locks a slashable stake before it can vouch for peers, and voting weight accrues only from verified work over successive epochs. A fresh identity enters through a narrow inlet: it may attest once per epoch and earns weight slowly, so spawning thousands of fakes means funding thousands of bonds and waiting out thousands of ramps. Misbehavior burns the bond and stains the identity sable in the public registry, while long-honest agents build an ivory record that peers can check before trusting them.
